text:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate fetching model artifacts from Hugging Face registry in us-west1 — elevated 429/503s observed (service: model-fetch). Please acknowledge.

sam-oncall: acked. I'm on it, will triage.

zoe-sre: I'm seeing a spike in 429s from the HF CDN for model artifact GETs: 
```
GET /models/gharrington/large-13B/resolve/main/pytorch_model.bin
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
```
Majority during cold-start paths where we fetch full checkpoints.

mike-mlinfra: same here — 503s intermittently for chunked downloads, clients fail fast. We have ~1200 cold start fetches/min across dedicated pools.

lina-cs: any active customers seeing failures? I already have a support ticket from customer "FlyApp" reporting degraded responses and longer cold starts.

sam-oncall: tagging @lina-cs — thanks. Lina, estimate impact: percentage of requests failing vs latency increase?

lina-cs: from logs: 6% of inferences returned error due to model-unavailable during last 20m for affected regions; some retail customers on Dedicated reported 10-30s extra latency while we retried.

zoe-sre: initial mitigation plan: 1) throttle internal cold-starts to reduce concurrent HF fetches 2) increase retries with exponential backoff + jitter 3) fall back to smaller quantized model variant cached locally 4) pre-warm caches for paying customers — need approvals.

mike-mlinfra: 1) I can flip admission control to limit concurrent artifact pulls from any single pool to 10/s temporarily. 2) Add header to prefer smaller artifact variant (we already host 8-bit versions).

jess-product: Can we automatically divert requests to our pre-pulled model shard storage (local mirrors) for high-tier customers now?

mike-mlinfra: we have an internal mirror with recent snapshots for ~60% of models. I can enable mirror routing for tiers > enterprise. That should cut HF pulls by ~40% in affected regions.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: artifetch-mirror-route-v1 -> staging (rolling).

zoe-sre: rolling policy: apply mirror-route to dedicated pools in us-west1, us-west2. Will monitor errors and token consumption.

hf-status-bot: Hugging Face status: Partial degradation — "higher error rates for artifact hosting" — https://status.huggingface.co/incidents/abc123 (last update 5m ago).

sam-oncall: good to reference. Lina: please notify affected customers that we are aware and working on mitigation; mention mirror fallback and ETA 30-60m.

lina-cs: doing that now. Drafting message: "We are seeing degraded model load times due to an upstream artifact hosting issue. We are routing traffic to our internal mirrors and applying mitigations. No data loss. Expect improvements within the hour. We'll update as we have more"

karen-support: FYI, LiveOps queue shows a spike in inbound chats about timeouts — routing alerts/KB link to cs.

zoe-sre: quick mitigations applied: admission controls enabled, mirror routing on for enterprise pools, retry backoff updated to cap at 45s. Monitoring dashboards updated.

sam-oncall: Observability note: set up an alert for artifact_fetch_429_rate > 2% sustained for 5m. Make sure runbooks referenced.

zoe-sre: done. Also enabled verbose logs on failing fetches for 10m window to collect headers and Retry-After values.

mike-mlinfra: mirror routing rollout to production complete for enterprise. We'll expand to standard if HF doesn't recover in 30m.

jess-product: Any plan for automatic prewarm for customers with SLAs? This looks like a recurring risk.

sam-oncall: we'll discuss later for longer-term. Right now, next steps: continue mitigation, monitor HF status, prepare handoff note for night oncall.

zoe-sre: current metrics (15m window): artifact 429/503 rate down from 6.5% -> 1.2% after mirror routing; cold-start latency reduced ~45% for mirrored workloads.

lina-cs: sent customer notifications to top 12 affected accounts. Some replies asking for SLA credits — forwarded to sales.

mike-mlinfra: rolling mirror expansion to standard pools in 5m. Will validate disk cache capacity.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: artifetch-mirror-route-v1 -> prod (75% rolled).

zoe-sre: mirror expansion started. Disk pressure is within limits but keep an eye.

sam-oncall: time check — 40m since alert. HF status still shows partial degradation; our mirrored routing has brought service to acceptable levels for enterprise and many standard customers.

hf-status-bot: Update: "We're continuing to investigate artifact hosting rate limits; mitigation in progress." (link same).

raj-oncall-next: stepping in for handoff in 20m. Any open action items for night?

zoe-sre: list for handoff to @raj-oncall-next: 1) keep artifact_fetch_429 alert sensitivity 2) expand mirror to any remaining pools if HF doesn't recover 3) revert admission control only after 60m stable 4) follow up with HF support for rate-limit exemptions for enterprise traffic.

sam-oncall: I'll prepare the incident summary for the postmortem: cause = upstream HF artifact hosting rate limits leading to 429/503 on cold-starts; mitigation = internal mirror routing, admission control, retry/backoff; impact = ~6% errors at peak, some enterprise customers impacted but largely restored; next steps = explore mirroring strategy, request HF exception, improve prewarm heuristics.

lina-cs: collecting customer logs and impact statements for postmortem.

karen-support: tagging in the ticket numbers.

sam-oncall: handoff to @raj-oncall-next in 20m. If anything spikes before then ping me. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

raj-oncall-next: ack. I'll take over and follow the runbook.

zoe-sre: adding incident channel note: "Mitigation applied: mirror routing + admission control; monitor artifact_fetch_4xx_rate"

sam-oncall: closing the active pager for me. Leaving channel open for follow-ups.
